title: Owner decides whether to switch the chat model to gemma4:26b
goal: The owner chooses gemma4:26b or keeps gemma4:12b from the speed and quality evidence
acceptance: The owner's decision (switch or keep, and why) is recorded with the date

2026-11-26 in chat, before the quality evidence: "gemma4:26b your main model"; the owner switched NERV-01's live roles (Misato, Casper, Consultant) to gemma4:26b the same day. The evidence of 2026-11-27 (docs/evaluations/2026-11-26-f126-t02-gemma4-26b-gauntlet.md) shows gemma4:12b as good or better on the planner (18/36 against 17/36), embedded (3/4 against 2/4) and cad-3d; the owner confirms the switch or goes back to gemma4:12b

Owner 2026-11-27 in chat: first "ok" (about 10:00) to going back to gemma4:12b, then (about 10:10) "Keep 26b, test more": gemma4:26b stays the main model on NERV-01 (no switch back), and the owner wants more evidence before the final choice: F-126-T05, F-126-T06 (26b with a larger reply cap and without thinking) and F-126-T07 (gauntlet all on gemma4:12b for comparison). This step closes when the owner confirms or changes the choice on that evidence
privacy: Local models only; no paid route, prompts are neutral fixtures, raw reports stay private on their base.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-25: reading the comparison report and choosing. Not a measurement.
